hints: Print the matrix only after an edge is ACCEPTED. An edge you reject for making a cycle produces no output at all.
The finished tree is printed twice: once as the last accepted-edge snapshot, and once more at the end before the cost. That is what the official sample shows.
Disconnected input prints a single -1 and no matrices at all - so decide connectivity before printing anything, or buffer the snapshots.
